properties.name: model-cards:integration_means
properties.value: Usable with the Hugging Face Transformers library (pip install -U transformers torch accelerate; load via AutoProcessor and AutoModelForMultimodalLM). Chat format uses system, assistant and user roles; thinking is enabled with the <|think|> token at the start of the system prompt.

properties.name: model-cards:distribution_channels
properties.value: Open-weights models (pre-trained and instruction-tuned variants) available on Hugging Face, loadable with the Transformers library

modelParameters.architectureFamily: Dense architecture (31B Dense) with hybrid attention interleaving local sliding window attention and full global attention; the Gemma 4 family includes Dense and Mixture-of-Experts variants
modelParameters.modelArchitecture: 31B Dense model: 30.7B parameters, 60 layers, 1024-token sliding window, 256K context, 262K vocabulary. Hybrid attention interleaves local sliding window attention with full global attention (final layer always global), giving the speed and low memory footprint of a lightweight model without sacrificing deep awareness for complex, long-context tasks. Global layers use unified Keys and Values and Proportional RoPE (p-RoPE) to optimize memory for long contexts.

performanceMetrics.value: Gemma 4 31B (instruction-tuned): MMLU Pro 85.2%; AIME 2026 no tools 89.2%; LiveCodeBench v6 80.0%; Codeforces ELO 2150; GPQA Diamond 84.3%; MMMU Pro 76.9%

fairnessAssessments.harms: The card acknowledges that VLMs trained on real-world data can reflect socio-cultural biases; mitigation consists of careful scrutiny, input data pre-processing, and post-training evaluations. Training data was filtered for CSAM, certain personal/sensitive data, and by content quality and safety. It also notes biases or gaps in training data can limit responses, and encourages continuous monitoring and exploration of de-biasing techniques.

useCases: Content creation and communication (text generation, chatbots and conversational AI, text summarization, image data extraction, audio processing and interaction for E2B/E4B/12B) and research and education (NLP and VLM research, language learning tools, knowledge exploration).
Chatbots/conversational AI (customer service, virtual assistants, interactive applications), and agentic workflows/autonomous agents via native function calling; also research foundation for VLM/NLP
technicalLimitations: Limitations include training data biases/gaps affecting responses; difficulty with open-ended or highly complex tasks; struggles with subtle nuances, sarcasm, figurative language; may generate incorrect or outdated factual statements; may lack common sense reasoning. Risks include generation of harmful content, misuse, privacy violations and perpetuation of biases.

ethicalConsiderations.name: Automated and human evaluations were conducted with internal safety and responsible AI teams, aligned with Google's AI principles and safety policies. Results: major improvements in all content safety categories relative to previous Gemma models; Gemma 4 significantly outperforms Gemma 3 and 3n on safety while keeping unjustified refusals low; testing was conducted without safety filters; minimal policy violations for text-to-text and image-to-text across all model sizes.

properties.name: model-cards:design_rationale
properties.value: The card gives rationales for some design choices. Hybrid attention (local sliding window interleaved with global) gives the speed and low memory footprint of a lightweight model without losing deep awareness for long-context tasks. Training data includes code to learn programming syntax and patterns, and mathematical text to learn logical reasoning, symbolic representation and to address mathematical queries.

properties.name: model-cards:languages
properties.value: Multilingual support in over 140 languages; out-of-the-box support for 35+ languages, pre-trained on 140+ languages

properties.name: model-cards:autonomy
properties.value: Card describes native function-calling support powering highly capable autonomous agents (agentic workflows).

properties.name: model-cards:standards_compliance
properties.value: Safety evaluations align with Google's AI principles and Google's safety policies. The card names no external standards or regulations such as ISO/IEC 42001 or the EU AI Act.
